pictures.observations: Full800x533 ordinary picture inspected: tall thin square/rounded monoliths and broken stela tops, two dark open rock-chapel portals, coarse layered lintel/boulder masses, fallen inscribed slabs and loose angular sandstone. No intact full temple or roofed compound.

pictures.observations: Full800x533 ordinary southern site view inspected: long low wall on left, open dusty walking gaps, dispersed broken low stone masses and tall narrow rounded stelae; rocky plateau outside. Individual stone positions/counts and reliefs cannot be surveyed from this single view.

pictures.observations: Full533x800 ordinary detail inspected: tall thin monolithic stela with rounded top, worn/chipped foot and shallow horizontal inscription registers. Warm neutral sandstone; no copied pixels or exact legible glyph text.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific Temple of Hathor ruins within the mapped enclosure: two western rock-chapel entrance masses, open doorways, irregular tall/rounded/broken sandstone stela groups, low surviving wall remnants and fallen slabs around an open compound. No complete restored Egyptian temple, roofed court, full deciphered inscription or mine complex. Internal group counts, room fragments and chapel assignment to western map jogs are explicit photo/map-shape approximations rather than surveyed archaeology.
